name: Nanocoder
description: Community-built terminal coding agent that favours local models through Ollama while also supporting OpenAI-compatible APIs.
whatItDoes: Nanocoder brings agentic coding to the terminal for people who want to stay local and provider-independent. It can edit files, run commands and review changes. Modes ranging from manual approval to fully automatic control how much freedom it has.
howItWorks: The CLI runs a tool loop against the configured provider. Operating modes (normal, auto-accept, yolo, plan, architect) change the approval behaviour, and external tool servers are declared in its configuration. A dedicated review command inspects code changes.

requirements.name: Model provider
requirements.description: A local Ollama server or an OpenAI-compatible or OpenRouter endpoint
